Walk_Loop.prompt: A person walks forward at a steady, relaxed pace, arms swinging naturally.

Jog_Fwd_Loop.prompt: A person jogs forward at an easy, relaxed pace with a long loose arm swing, each hand swinging back past the hip and forward to the belly, shoulders down and relaxed.

Sprint_Loop.prompt: A person sprints forward at full speed, leaning forward, arms driving hard back and forth.

Idle_Loop.prompt: A person stands still and relaxed, weight on both feet, arms hanging loosely at the sides, breathing calmly and shifting their weight slightly.
